units.source_text: 希腊神话中，无论月亮还是星星，甚至动物和植物，都被看作是神。

en.t: In Greek mythology, whether the moon or the stars, even animals and plants, were all regarded as gods.

units.source_text: 所谓神的感情，有哭有笑，同人并无二致。

en.t: The feelings of these so-called gods included both weeping and laughter, no different from those of human beings.

units.source_text: 这样的神话就像赤着身子在晴天下的青草上舞蹈一样，是健康的。

en.t: Such mythology is healthy, like dancing naked on green grass under a clear sky.
